text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho declared that she would cast 
her racing magic upon the entire world at 
the Takarazuka Kinen. Learning of this, 
Zenno Rob Roy steeled her resolve—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Achieve the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, 
become Horse of the Year, and as the 
representative of Umamusume from the 
Triple Crown route, vanquish the witch at 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the final piece needed to complete 
the racing magic was decided— a "special 
rival."
